definition: What-if responses from the forecaster of record. Baseline: the published forecast median for this country, issued from its last observed year, at 1, 3, 5 and 10 years. Shocked: the forecast median after a LARGE MOVE in one node: its latest value moved by 0.5 standard deviations of its level, up ('shocks') or down ('shocks_fall'), everything else as observed. Structural nodes are not shocked. Each horizon is forecast directly. A response is the change in the forecast when one variable is different today: a statement about prediction, not an estimate of a causal effect. Levels in standard deviations of each node (mean and SD over all country-years of the panel).

stability.mode: not applicable: each horizon is forecast directly

method: forecaster of record, asked again with one input changed
